summary: Nubra drops the socket after a priced book: the subscriptions go again on the new connection, and the first book on it, without an LTP, reaches the Depth holder with LTP 0, nothing from before the drop (R107-11).

deviations.reason: The web pads a short side of Nubra's book to five zero levels (price 0, an integer) Nubra never sent; the desktop sends the levels Nubra sent.
Nubra's order book carries the last traded quantity; the web drops it from the frames it builds on the book, the desktop keeps it (lost data).
A depth frame keeps ltp (0 before the first trade on the connection) as a double; the web's is the integer 0.
No trade yet on the new connection: the message carries no volume; the web sends volume 0, the desktop leaves it out.
